labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reports a failure in Rich's tests with a newer Pygments; a bug claim.

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: No runnable example, Rich version or platform details in the report.

body:
Could you add a minimal runnable example that shows the wrong output? A short script using Rich's API that reproduces the failure is more useful than the full test output. Please also include your Rich version and platform by pasting the output of `python -m rich.diagnose`, and the Pygments version you installed.

Related: #3088 reported a similar test failure with an earlier Pygments release.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
